title: Coefficient sample count bound
statement: Let $n$ be a natural number, let $P\subseteq[n]$, let $k$ be a natural number, and let $\delta\in\mathbb{Q}$ satisfy $0<\delta\leq1/2$. Let $\mathcal F$ be the family of subsets of the coordinates outside $P$ of size at most $\lfloor3k/4\rfloor$, and set $\gamma=\delta/(4|\mathcal F|)$. The coefficient sample count for accuracy $1/(3\cdot2^k)$ and confidence $\gamma$ is at most $36\cdot4^k$ times the number of failure bits associated with $\gamma$.
